detail.longDescription: Hi Mastodon 👋 I'm Jacko, an indie maker from Mexico City. I build small free web apps and games, all in English and Spanish: 🌙 Nightlit, a daily light-tile puzzle: https:// playnightlit.com 🧾 Parejo, a no-sign-up trip bill splitter: https:// getparejo.com 🎨 Paleta, a 60-second colour season quiz: https:// paletacolor.com ✨ GlowStreak, a glow-up habit tracker: https:// glowstreak.pages.dev ⚽ Efectazo, a 3D free-kick game: https:// efectazo.pages.dev Feedback very welcome. # introduction # indiedev # webdev
